          About this item

          • 【MFi Certified for Find My】Apple MFi-certified smart tracker that works seamlessly with the Find My network via the built-in Find My app. No app download, SIM, or subscription required. Easily track keys, wallets, luggage, and bags with smart tag.
          • 【Long-Lasting Battery Life】Powered by a replaceable CR2032 battery (210mAh) with up to 365 days standby. Compact air tracker with keychain holder for keys, backpacks, luggage, or pet collars.
          • 【Loud Sound for Location】Play a loud alert through the Find My app to quickly locate nearby items as long as it is within Bluetooth range. The smart tag's beeps help you quickly locate lost keys inside couches, bags, or wallets.
          • 【Lost & Sharing Mode Support】Use the Share Device feature to let up to 5 users (same ID required) view the tag’s location. Smart item tracker with encrypted Lost Mode for easy Item Recovery. Cannot be paired again if lost or stolen.
          • 【2 Pack Air Trackers】Includes 2 tracker tags to track keys, wallets, luggage, and bags. Easy to attach, carry, and track items at home, travel, or daily use.
